description: This file defines a PermissionManager utility along with helper classes and enums for managing and requesting system permissions on macOS, including location, notifications, camera, microphone, screen recording, speech recognition, and AppleScript automation. It includes methods for checking current permission statuses, requesting permissions interactively, and opening system settings for user intervention.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: Helps request location permissions and handles delegate callbacks for authorization status changes, including timeout handling.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: Singleton class that monitors and maintains current permission statuses, periodically checking permissions and notifying other parts of the app.

classes.name: AppleScriptPermission
classes.description: Provides methods to check and request automation permissions for AppleScript interactions.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingProbe
classes.description: Provides methods to check and request access to screen recording features.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if the current location authorization status satisfies the 'always' requirement.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures a set of capabilities are granted, returning a dictionary of results.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Checks and potentially requests a specific capability interactively.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the provided capabilities.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Open system settings for specific permissions like notifications, camera, microphone, or location.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location permission, with handling for user prompts and timeout.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if AppleScript automation permission is granted.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Triggers the automation permission prompt and opens system settings if needed.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Begins periodic checks of permission statuses.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Performs the permission status check and updates internal state if changes are detected.
